titleStmt.title: Kephalaia of the Teacher, edition page 34: diplomatic and Leiden transcription

sourceDesc.bibl: Kephalaia (Manichäische Handschriften der Staatlichen Museen Berlin), ed. H. J. Polotsky and A. Böhlig, Stuttgart: Kohlhammer, 34. Restorations, sublinear dots, gap counts and corrections are the editors'.

encodingDesc.p: EpiDoc. Read by eye from the page image; gap counts, sublinear dots and supralinear stroke extents verified by measurement on the image. A supralinear stroke is marked on every letter it covers by at least half its width. Spaces are the edition's word division. Facsimile zones are measured line centres. The editors' German statements are not transcribed: each is mapped to an id of the controlled vocabulary data/kephalaia/editorial_vocabulary.json and carried as @ana (ed: statements in the text, app: apparatus footnotes, tr: categories of the transcriber's commentary).

div.p: The framed manuscript page number ⲗⲇ is printed with a bar above and below as the frame, not as a supralinear stroke. Measured strokes over ⲛ of ⲡⲃⲁⲥⲛϭ (626–639) and ⲛ of ⲛ⟨ⲛ⟩ⲟⲩⲕⲁⲣⲡⲟⲥ (897–909).
Measured overlines over both ⲡⲛⲁ (743–788 and 1197–1242), each covering ⲡ, ⲛ and ⲁ (58 %), not the first ⲡ.
Strokes over ⲛ of ϩⲛ (801–813), the first ⲙ of ⲙⲙⲁⲛⲧⲓⲥ (837–850) and ⲛ of ⲥⲥⲛϣⲓⲛⲉ (1045–1057).
Measured stroke over ϩⲛ (1050–1068, pixel row): ϩ 50 %, ⲛ 57 %, encoded on both. The dot under ⲡ of ⲧⲩⲡⲟ[ⲥ] (x ≈ 903) is faint (area 2) but clear at 6×.
The stroke over ⲙⲛ (613–632, pixel row) covers ⲙ 47 %, ⲛ 57 %: encoded on ⲛ only. Measured overline over ⲡⲛⲁ of ⲛⲕⲉⲡⲛⲁ (711–756).

Stroke over the first ⲙ of ⲙⲡϣⲙϣⲉ (732–745).

A point (x ≈ 927, area 9, slightly below line centre) stands after ϣⲁⲁⲛⲏϩⲉ at the end of kephalaion 6; the draft markup has no sign for it, so it is recorded in this note only. Measured stroke over ⲙⲛ (562–582, pixel row): ⲙ 50 %, ⲛ 60 %, encoded on both.
